# Copilot instructions for Canhub Website V2

## Project goals

- Build a modern, maintainable website foundation using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the App Router.
- Keep branding and content factual, conservative, and stakeholder-safe.
- Prefer reusable design patterns and centralized content over duplicated strings.
- Keep the site architecture scalable for future milestone work.

## Non-negotiable rules

- Do not invent company achievements, client testimonials, partnerships, awards, or performance claims.
- Do not add unverified stats, metrics, or success stories to any page or document.
- Do not implement future milestone pages before Milestone 1 is complete and validated.
- Keep all provisional content clearly structured and easy to replace.
- Use TypeScript strict mode and prefer type-safe patterns.

## Coding expectations

- Favor small, reusable components over large page-specific components.
- Keep shared styling tokens centralized in CSS variables or a config object.
- Use semantic HTML and accessible interaction patterns.
- Prefer real rendered behavior checks over mock-only testing.
- Ensure responsive layout behavior on mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

## Validation expectations

- ESLint, TypeScript checks, and relevant tests should be run before reporting completion.
- Do not claim the fix is complete without fresh validation output.
- If a check fails, resolve the root cause before continuing.

## Documentation expectations

- Maintain project docs under the docs directory.
- Keep the progress log updated as work advances.
- Use factual, approved content only.
